role_registry.name: Admin
role_registry.source: prd:user_stories(as_a=admin), prd:user_flows(primary_role=admin), prototype:Login(persona 'System Admin'), prototype:AdminUsers(role matrix column 'Admin')
role_registry.notes: Privileged role. Full access to all features and data. Owns /admin/* route group.

role_registry.name: Content Manager
role_registry.source: prd:user_personas(Sarah Chen, application role content_manager), prd:user_journeys(actor content_manager), prototype:Login(persona 'Content Manager'), prototype:AdminUsers(role matrix column 'Content Mgr')
role_registry.notes: Canonical id for the PRD's 'content_team_member' (used in user_stories.as_a and user_flows.primary_role). Owns the publishing route group.

role_registry.name: Editor
role_registry.source: prototype:AdminUsers(role matrix column 'Editor'), prototype:AdminUsers(invite dialog option 'Editor')
role_registry.notes: Prototype-derived sub-tier of the content team. Same publishing surface as content_manager minus privileged capabilities (4K upload, API keys, security config).

role_registry.name: Contributor
role_registry.source: prototype:AdminUsers(role matrix column 'Contributor'), prototype:AdminUsers(invite dialog option 'Contributor (Draft Only)')
role_registry.notes: Prototype-derived read/draft-only tier. Read-only on Post (index/show, no store) — satisfies the host-runtime read-only role contract.

coverage_matrix.status: partial — no story covers the /admin/system-settings surface itself (see G3)
partial — story AC names /admin/monitoring, sitemap names /admin/system-reports (see G4)

gaps.message: Sitemap page '/' (Dashboard) has no user story with an acceptance criterion. The prototype Landing page is a rich content-overview dashboard (metrics, recent posts table, batch actions) but no PRD story defines its behaviour.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add a Dashboard screen to the plan (route '/'), back it with Post + AnalyticsData aggregates, and add a compensated AC row (compensated_from_gap=SITEMAP_PAGE_NO_AC) asserting the dashboard renders reach metrics and the recent-posts list.

gaps.message: Sitemap page '/admin' (Admin Panel) has no user story with an acceptance criterion. The prototype Admin page is a module launcher + infrastructure health panel.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add an Admin overview screen (route '/admin') and a compensated AC row asserting admin-only access and the module links.

gaps.message: Sitemap page '/admin/system-settings' has no user story with an acceptance criterion, yet the prototype implements organization identity, video encoding, and security/SSO settings forms.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add a SystemSetting model + screen and a compensated AC row asserting an admin can read and update organization/encoding/security settings.

gaps.message: Sitemap page '/admin/system-reports' has no matching AC: the 'System Health Monitoring' story AC3 names '/admin/monitoring', which is not in the sitemap. The prototype AdminSystemReports page is also an ungenerated placeholder.
gaps.compensation_hint: Plan the /admin/system-reports screen (SystemReport model + custom health endpoint), reconcile the route name to the sitemap, and add a compensated AC row for the monitoring dashboard.

gaps.message: The 'Admin Login' story AC3 ('Successful login redirects admin to /admin/dashboard') references /admin/dashboard, which does not exist in the sitemap (sitemap has /admin).
gaps.compensation_hint: Reconcile the admin post-login landing to the sitemap route '/admin' and add a compensated AC row asserting admin login redirects to /admin.

gaps.message: The 'Login' user_flow says content_team_member lands on '/' after login, while the 'Admin Login' story says admin lands on /admin/dashboard. The two describe the same action with different destinations and no role-conditional rule is stated.
gaps.compensation_hint: Plan role-conditional post-login redirect: admin -> /admin, content_manager/editor/contributor -> /. Document in the plan and cover with a compensated AC row.

gaps.message: Three user stories use as_a='system' ('System Health Monitoring', 'Data Backup and Restore', 'Role-Based Access Control'). 'system' is not a user role and cannot be granted permissions or routed.
gaps.compensation_hint: Re-attribute these stories to the admin role for the user-facing surfaces (monitoring dashboard, restore trigger, RBAC enforcement) and treat the automated parts (daily backup, alerting) as backend Extras. Normalize _roles.yaml to the role_registry.

gaps.message: The PRD uses two names for the same role: 'content_manager' (persona/journeys) and 'content_team_member' (user_stories.as_a, user_flows.primary_role).
gaps.compensation_hint: Canonicalize to 'content_manager' in _roles.yaml and document the content_team_member -> content_manager mapping in the plan.

gaps.message: The admin persona (Alex Thorne / 'System Admin' in the prototype) has no user_journey, though admin stories and flows exist.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add an admin journey note in the plan (login -> /admin -> manage users/integrations/settings/reports) and ensure the admin route group is fully routed in ui-handoff.json.

gaps.message: The Post model in the PRD schema has only organization_id, user_id, title, content, status, published_at. The prototype reads post.category, post.slug, post.tags, post.readTime, post.hasVideo, post.views, post.date — none of which exist in the schema.
gaps.compensation_hint: Extend the Post blueprint with slug (string), category (string), tags (jsonb), read_time_minutes (integer), view_count (integer), scheduled_at (datetime); expose has_video as a computed attribute derived from the videos association. Emit the exact camelCase keys the JSX reads via a serializer/computed attributes.

gaps.message: The Video model in the PRD schema has title, url, duration only, and post_id is a required reference. The prototype media library reads asset.type, asset.format, asset.size, asset.resolution, asset.bitrate, asset.duration (as a display string) and lists assets that are NOT attached to any post.
gaps.compensation_hint: Extend the Video blueprint with media_type, format, file_size, resolution, bitrate, description, thumbnail_url, status; make post_id nullable (media-library assets are standalone). Store duration_seconds (integer) and expose a computed 'duration' display string (MM:SS) to match the JSX.

gaps.message: AnalyticsData has only event_type, event_data, recorded_at. The prototype analytics dashboard reads total impressions, unique readers, engagement rate, watch time, per-day reader/video series, and a leaderboard with views/watchTime/completion/shares — none derivable from the current columns alone.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add visitor_id (string) to AnalyticsData for unique-visitor counting, and plan a custom aggregate endpoint (GET /api/analytics/summary) that returns the exact keys the JSX reads (total_impressions, unique_readers, engagement_rate, watch_time_hours, daily_series, leaderboard).

gaps.message: Three user-story ACs require User columns that the PRD schema does not list: 'The data model stores approved', 'profile completed', 'first name', 'last name'. The sample_data users table also carries approved, profile_completed, first_name, last_name, sign_in_count.
gaps.compensation_hint: Add a migration extending the core users table with first_name, last_name, approved (boolean), profile_completed (boolean). Document as an Extra since User is provided_by rhino_project_core and cannot be expressed in a blueprint.

gaps.message: Sitemap routes /admin, /admin/system-settings and /admin/system-reports are admin-only surfaces but no acceptance criterion explicitly asserts the auth/role gate for them (only the generic RBAC story covers /admin routes).
gaps.compensation_hint: Add auth/roles gating in ui-handoff.json for every /admin/* page and add a compensated AC row asserting a content_manager/editor/contributor is redirected away from /admin/* while admin is allowed.

gaps.message: The prototype page AdminSystemReports is an ungenerated placeholder ('Page Not Generated') even though the PRD sitemap requires /admin/system-reports with health, reports and audit-log sections.
gaps.compensation_hint: Plan a real /admin/system-reports screen (SystemReport model + custom health endpoint) in the user's design idiom; ui-integration scaffolds the missing sections. Add a compensated AC row.

gaps.message: The 'Connect to Marketing Tools' story AC1 names '/admin/integrations' while the sitemap and prototype use '/admin/api-integrations'.
gaps.compensation_hint: Use the sitemap/prototype route '/admin/api-integrations' as canonical and note the reconciliation in the plan.

gaps.message: Post.status enum vocabulary differs: PRD sample_data uses 'Published'/'Draft' (capitalized) while the prototype uses 'Published'/'Draft'/'Scheduled'.
gaps.compensation_hint: Define the Post status enum as lowercase draft/published/scheduled and have the serializer emit the capitalized display label the JSX renders (ContentStatusBadge normalizes case, so either works — pick lowercase storage + display label).

hints_for_planner: Canonicalize roles to admin, content_manager, editor, contributor in _roles.yaml; map PRD 'content_team_member' -> content_manager and drop the non-user 'system' role (re-attribute its stories to admin + backend Extras).

Extend Post, Video and AnalyticsData blueprints with the prototype-read fields (category, slug, tags, read_time_minutes, view_count, has_video; media_type, format, file_size, resolution, bitrate, description, nullable post_id, duration display string; visitor_id) so the shipped JSX has real data to bind to.

Add models for the prototype-only admin surfaces: Integration, ApiToken, Webhook, SystemSetting, SystemReport, RolePermission.

Add compensated AC rows for every high-severity gap: dashboard (/), admin overview (/admin), system settings, system reports, admin login redirect, and the /admin/* role gate.
Every /admin/* page must carry roles:['admin'] in ui-handoff.json; publishing pages carry roles:['content_manager','editor'] (contributor read-only).
Seed all four Role rows plus a UsersRole per demo user (Sarah Chen=content_manager, Alex Thorne=admin, plus an editor and a contributor) or useRoles()/policies deny everything.
